summary: Iteration 108 — XOS (Layout Builder + UI Rules + Content Manager + Menu Tracking) tested backend + frontend. Backend: 20/20 tests pass covering all XOS endpoints, ui-rules eval (hide/show_if, eq/gte, role/account_age_days), site-content banner persistence, and menu track+analytics. Frontend: admin XOS Builder (5 widgets, toggle+save+reset) OK; UI Rules add+save+delete OK; Content Manager banner activate → banner appears on homepage with correct text OK; client V2 dashboard renders v2-actions + v2-discover by default AND correctly hides v2-discover when admin disables the widget + restores after reset; menu click tracking increments analytics (5→8) and design_interior shows in top. REGRESSION FOUND: Business Health page (/admin/business-health) crashes on load with 'menuStats is not defined' — page completely broken, cannot render bh-menu-clicks card OR any other health department.

minor.issue: No auth required — anyone can read the widget layout. Acceptable per spec (public GET) but exposes internal widget ids to competitors.
Sanitizer silently drops invalid conditions/rules (e.g. unknown field or op) with no feedback to admin. Consider returning validation errors so admin knows a bad condition was ignored.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: menuStats is not defined. Line 106/110/111/112 reference `menuStats` but the variable/state is NEVER declared and no fetch to /api/admin/site-menu/analytics is made in load(). ENTIRE page crashes (React error boundary shows 'Ceva nu a mers cum trebuie · menuStats is not defined'). bh-menu-clicks card cannot render. All 8 department scores also blocked because the whole tree throws.

integration_issues.issue: Menu analytics data (fetched from /api/admin/site-menu/analytics — backend returns correct data) is not wired into the page state; missing useState + fetch call.

action_items: URGENT — Fix BusinessHealthPage.jsx: add `const [menuStats, setMenuStats] = useState(null);` and inside `load()` fetch `ax.get('/admin/site-menu/analytics?days=30')` in the Promise.all and setMenuStats(res.data). Currently the whole /admin/business-health page is unusable (React error boundary).
(Optional) UI Rules — validation feedback: return sanitizer warnings when rules have invalid conditions/ops/fields.
critical_code_review_comments: BusinessHealthPage.jsx: `menuStats` referenced but never declared/fetched — clear developer oversight, would have been caught by a lint step (no-undef) or a simple render test.
xos.py `_cond_match`: `verified` field converts value to bool but not actual (line 122-123). Works if `actual` is already bool. Consider normalizing both sides.
xos.py `_user_ctx`: `age_days = 0` fallback used when created_at parse fails — silently. OK for now but log a warning.
xos.py `admin_put_layout` rejects empty layouts with 400 — good defense.
SiteNav.jsx line 79: track fires but doesn't `await` — fire-and-forget. If backend track endpoint fails silently, no user-visible issue but analytics loses events. Acceptable trade-off.
AnnouncementBanner uses sessionStorage `pm_announce_dismissed` — good UX; per-tab session so admins testing get fresh banner each new tab.
ContentManagerPage.jsx `banner-preview` reactively shows text — good for admin UX.

Frontend admin pages (XOS Builder testid xos-builder-page, UI Rules testid ui-rules-page, Content Manager testid content-manager-page) all render and save correctly. rca of the issue: BusinessHealthPage.jsx — main agent added the bh-menu-clicks JSX block referencing `menuStats` but forgot the state declaration + fetch. Repro: as admin GET /admin/business-health → React error boundary triggers with 'menuStats is not defined' (visible in DOM as inline error). Backend endpoint /api/admin/site-menu/analytics works fine (verified separately returns total_clicks=8 + top=[design_interior,...]). Fix (2 lines): (1) add `const [menuStats, setMenuStats] = useState(null);` near line 44. (2) In load(), extend Promise.all to include `ax.get('/admin/site-menu/analytics?days=30')` and destructure result into setMenuStats(m.data). No backend change needed.
